name: CaDoMi.ai
description: Connect AI assistants to CaDoMi.ai, an AI-native product management and Agile delivery platform. Plan and refine product backlogs, create user stories and acceptance criteria, prepare and manage sprints, assess team agility, surface delivery risks, analyze capacity and performance, and get context-aware guidance for Product Owners, Scrum Masters, Agile Coaches, developers, leaders, and delivery teams. CaDoMi.ai brings product planning, delivery intelligence, coaching, and continuous improvement together to help teams build better products and deliver measurable value.

_published_faq.name: How do I add CaDoMi.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add CaDoMi.ai to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.cadomi.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the CaDoMi.ai MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: CaDoMi.ai lists 16 MCP tools, including create_stories, get_backlog_stories, get_current_sprint, get_product, get_product_id, get_rubric_info, get_sprint_by_name, get_sprint_stories, get_sprint_summary, get_story_id, get_team_id, and get_team_members.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to CaDoMi.ai?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to CaDoMi.ai in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
CaDoMi.ai requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
CaDoMi.ai is developed by Scrum Adventures, Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
